name: Digivated Membership
custom_summary: Unlimited launches, each live the moment you publish. $5 once.
description:
Launch as much as you want.

Membership is $5, paid once. It's not a subscription and nothing renews.

You get unlimited project uploads, and each one goes live the moment you publish. No review queue, no badge needed. Starter caps you at 3 projects. Membership doesn't.

How to use it

Buy with the email you use on Digivated. Then open https://digivated.com/new-launch and press “I’ve paid, check again”. Your account switches to unlimited right away.

News and your first launch stay free for everyone. Projects still follow the listing rules, and traffic or sales aren't guaranteed.
custom_receipt: Thanks for joining Digivated. Your $5 Membership is a one-time purchase with unlimited project uploads, each live the moment you publish. Use the same email as your Digivated account, then press “I’ve paid, check again” at https://digivated.com/new-launch. Keep your license key private.
